collectionObj.description:
The reference to the underlying collection
which can either be a {@link UploadedFileCollection} or {@link UploadedParsableDiagramCollection}.

numFiles.description: The number of {@link SourceParsableDiagram}s or {@link ParsableDiagram}s being tracked

parsingStatus.description: The current status of the parsing job.

uploadedOn.description: The timestamp of which the underlying collection type was created.

parsableDiagrams.description: The collection of {@link ParsableDiagram}s associated with this collection.

sourceParsableDiagrams.description: The collection of {@link SourceParsableDiagram}s associated with this collection.

title:
This helper will is used to get the statuses of the parsing job.
It accounts for checking the parsing status of {@link ParsableDiagram} and {@link SourceParsableDiagram}.
name: ParsingJobStatusHelper
